name: chinamaxm
description: Expose non-Claude worker models as native subagents of Claude Code and Codex, routed through one local Proxy.

interface.longDescription: Generate native Claude and Codex subagents for non-Claude worker models (DeepSeek, MiMo, GLM, MiniMax, Kimi, Qwen), each routed through one local Proxy to its provider.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use ChinamaXM to delegate a task to a non-Claude worker model as a native subagent.
